# Pitfalls

- `openapi/api.ts` is auto-generated — never edit it; run `bun api:generate`
- `messages/*.po` are auto-extracted by next-intl — don't manually add or edit entries
- `public/sw.js` is generated by Serwist from `app/sw.ts` — edit the source, not the output (it is gitignored, and the service worker is disabled in dev)
- `eslint-config-mahir` handles import ordering and class name sorting — those lint errors auto-fix on save
- TypeScript uses `verbatimModuleSyntax`: type-only imports must use `import type`
- Package manager is **bun** — use `bun add` / `bun run`, never `npm` or `yarn`
- `next build` runs with `--webpack`; the pre-commit hook runs `bun typecheck`
